meta.title: Who Is Actually Paying for the AI Boom?

overlays.text: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion, progressively as each gigawatt is deployed.
The prepaid and customer supplied hardware portions of our large AI contracts now total $75 billion.
What is left over to fuel that revolutionary agentic AI is not only substantially less than you thought, and all of it justified.
overlays.attribution: Jensen Huang, NVIDIA — U.S.–Saudi Investment Forum, November 2025

overlays.text: Now you know which numbers to watch.
